name: week
title: This week
subtitle: Filings, cliffs, leavers and rule checks across every company, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Filings overdue or due soon
sections.sql: select company, kind filing, subject_ref subject, due_on, state, days_left, detail from cap.obligations where state in ('OVERDUE','due soon') order by due_on

sections.title: Vesting in the next 30 days
sections.note: Cliffs vest a year's worth at once.
sections.sql: select company, vests_on, holder, grant_code, quantity, case when cliff then 'CLIFF' else '' end cliff from cap.vest_events where vests_on between current_date and current_date + 30 order by vests_on

sections.title: Leavers with options to exercise
sections.sql: select company, holder, grant_code, exercisable, window_ends_on, days_left from cap.leavers where not expired and exercisable > 0 order by days_left

sections.title: Rule checks
sections.sql: select company, severity, rule, subject, detail from cap.compliance_findings order by severity, company

sections.title: Holders
sections.sql: select company, name, kind, ordinary, preference, options, fully_diluted, issued_pct, fd_pct from cap.cap_table order by company, kind = 'pool', fully_diluted desc

sections.title: Option pools
sections.sql: select company, plan, pool_size, granted, exercised, outstanding, returned, available from cap.pool order by company

sections.title: SAFEs and notes
sections.sql: select company, code, holder, kind, currency, principal_cents, owed_cents, valuation_cap_cents, discount_pct, maturity_on, status from cap.convertible_status order by company, status
